originality.rationale: PASS: Salako–Wu explicitly ask in Remark 3.6 whether extinction can occur at total N between max{∫S0,∫r} and their threshold Nstar; their theorem permits but does not realize it. The identified source Corollary 3.5 assumes constant β or fixed-sign risk, both false here. Castellano–Salako analyze equilibria with positive susceptible movement, not the displayed initial-value extinction at zero movement. This is a constructive answer to a published model-specific gap, not a new statement about all masses.
